title: Mount and install the new tires
goal: The new tires mounted, balanced and on the car at the right pressure.
summary: The new tires are on hand but not mounted, because the car can't be driven to a shop. The fix is to take the wheels to the shop instead of the car: pull them, mount and balance them there, and put them back on. Pair the rears with the rear shock and shackle job.
next_step: Read the size and DOT date code off the new tires and the old ones, and check that the size suits the wheels.

subprojects.title: Check the tires and wheels
subprojects.goal: Confirm the new tires fit the wheels and record their details.

tasks.text: Write down the size, brand and load/speed rating from the new tires' sidewalls
Read the 4-digit DOT date code on each new tire (week and year)
tasks.detail: Tires age even in storage; good to know how old these are.

tasks.text: Check the wheels for cracks, bends and rust at the bead seat, and note their size (stamped inside)
Decide on new valve stems; have the shop put them in when mounting
tasks.detail: Cheap, and the old rubber stems are probably hardened.

subprojects.title: Get them mounted and balanced
subprojects.goal: All four new tires mounted and balanced on the wheels.

tasks.text: Pull the wheels with the car on jack stands; mark which corner each came from
tasks.detail: Pull the rears together with the rear shock and shackle job. With the engine out the front is light; set stands under the frame, not the suspension.

tasks.text: Take the wheels and tires to a tire shop to mount and balance

subprojects.title: Put them on the car
subprojects.goal: Wheels back on and torqued, pressures set.

tasks.text: Put the wheels on and tighten the lug nuts in a star pattern, finishing at the torque spec for your wheels and studs
tasks.detail: Look up the lug torque for your wheels and record it here.

tasks.text: Set the tire pressures to the door-sticker or tire-shop recommendation
Re-torque the lug nuts after the first ~50 miles

parts.name: New tires
parts.notes: Size, brand and quantity not recorded yet. Is there a spare too?

parts.name: Valve stems
parts.notes: Shop usually supplies these at mounting.

open_questions.text: What size and brand are the new tires, and is there a fifth for the spare?
